method.note: set c400: every task shares one 400-function program per representation (same names, semantics, and order); the structured A0 view is per-function while the structured and conventional TS/Rust views are the whole file, which is what an agent editing a real file reads

tokenizerNote: setup/view/output token counts are local js-tiktoken counts (OpenAI encodings), not the vendor tokenizer; providerUsage carries the billed counts when live.

design.setupCounted: A0 cells carry MODEL_GUIDE.txt as language instructions; TS and Rust cells carry a u32 semantics note; all carry their protocol instructions. Rust acceptance compiles with rustc -O and runs generated checks; Python, Go, Java, C# and C++ cells carry their own u32 semantics note and are accepted by python3, go build, javac, dotnet build and clang++ with a generated driver (tools/ai-edit-langs.ts).
design.unknowns: Hidden reasoning tokens are not reported by the API and are recorded as null.
